The '''Futility Station system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in an outlying region of the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|299|Futility Station}}</ref> within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a small [[Unidentified airless moon (Futility Station)|airless moon]], which was the location of a failed [[Mining/Legends|mining]] survey site known as "[[LMCTS-25452|Futility Station]]" that later became a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] safehouse.<ref name="H&S" />
